name: walkcam
description: PARITY-WALKCAM: enter walk mode (Pro), verify FOV + eye-height sliders show, screenshot at low/high FOV and low/high eye-height to confirm the view visibly changes.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: open-appearance
steps.failMessage: WalkSettings renders INSIDE the Appearance popover (AppearancePopover.tsx), so it has to be opened before the sliders exist.

steps.name: verify-walk-settings-section
steps.failMessage: 'Walk settings' section missing — WalkSettings gates on the `walkCameraControls` flag AND cameraMode==='firstPerson'.

steps.name: verify-fov-slider
steps.failMessage: Field-of-view slider missing in firstPerson + Pro. This assertion used to wait on `.walk-cam-controls`, a class that exists NOWHERE in src — so it had been failing since it was written and the scenario never reached its own FOV/eye-height shots (fixed v0.31.8.92).

steps.name: close-appearance
steps.failMessage: the popover must close again, or it sits in frame for every scene screenshot below

steps.name: appearance-closed
steps.failMessage: Appearance popover did not close. Asserted on the SLIDER unmounting, not on the 'Walk settings' label text — a text `visible: false` ignores opacity and can be satisfied while the panel is still painted (v0.31.8.88).
